Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d

Class AboutDialog

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.AboutDialog
public final class AboutDialog extends Object
A reusable "About" box for the 2D/Swing desktop's application windows.

Every panel application the 2D desktop hosts is a Desktop2DWindow, whose menu bar carries a Help → About <App> item that opens this dialog. It reads what the shared .lgcfg start-menu descriptor already supplies - the application's title and description (via Desktop2DMenuConfig.ItemSpec) - and always credits the same author, "Jean-Francois Landreville", alongside the resolved build version. One helper therefore gives every 2D application a consistent About box with no per-application code.

This is the per-application About box; it is distinct from the desktop-wide product About window (org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.about), which describes Project Looking Glass itself. The dialog assembly needs a display, so all of the content logic lives in pure, headless-testable static helpers (displayTitle(java.lang.String), displayDescription(java.lang.String), resolveVersion(java.lang.String, java.lang.String), buildContent(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, javax.swing.Icon)) - the same model/view split the rest of the desktop uses.

  • Method Details

    • getVersion

      public static String getVersion()
      Resolves the build version from the "lg.version" system property (set by the Gradle run task to the canonical project version), falling back to this jar's manifest and then to UNKNOWN_VERSION. Never hardcodes a literal, so a version bump cannot miss it.

    • show

      public static void show(Component owner, String title, String description, Icon icon)
      Shows a modal About box for title over owner, presenting the application's description, icon, the fixed "Jean-Francois Landreville" author credit and the resolved build version.
      Parameters:
      owner - the component the dialog is centred over and made modal to (a Desktop2DWindow resolves to its top-level desktop window); may be null
      title - the application name
      description - the application description from its descriptor
      icon - the application icon, or null for none
